summary: SENDbakēd Phase E — Multi-stop trip builder tested end-to-end. Backend regression: all 26 pytests pass (test_send_phase_b/c/e). Curl POST /api/express/quote/multi_stop confirms extra_stop_surcharge = 500 XOF × extra shipments. Frontend: MultiStopBuilder renders on Step 3 with first shipment locked, add/remove/reorder + counter chip 1/8→3/8 all work, address selector opens on '+ Ajouter une expédition'. Step 4 renders 4 eligible vehicles (bike/three_wheeler/mini_truck/truck) with LIVE prices sourced from POST /api/express/quote/multi_stop. Step counter reads 'Étape n sur 4' throughout. CARGO tile correctly shows package chips (no MultiStopBuilder). ONE BUG FOUND: the ⓘ price breakdown on Step 4 does NOT render an `extra_stop_surcharge` line even though the API payload contains it — review requirement violation.

ui_bugs.issue: Multi-stop quote payload returns `extra_stop_surcharge` (verified 500 XOF/extra stop) but the vehicle breakdown JSX only renders base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, surcharge (>0), service_fee, insurance, taxes, promo_discount. The `extra_stop_surcharge` field is silently absorbed into the total. Review requirement: 'The ⓘ info icon per card expands an inline breakdown that includes extra_stop_surcharge when 2+ shipments.' Fix: add `{q.extra_stop_surcharge > 0 && <Row label={t("send.wizard.extra_stop_surcharge", { n: q.extra_stops })} value={money(q.extra_stop_surcharge)} />}` after the surcharge row (~line 722), and add the FR/EN i18n key `send.wizard.extra_stop_surcharge` (e.g. 'Arrêts supplémentaires ({{n}})').

action_items: Render an `extra_stop_surcharge` line in the inline vehicle breakdown on Step 4 whenever `q.extra_stop_surcharge > 0` (multi-stop only). Add corresponding i18n string in fr/en customer.json.

Update review-request/documentation: actual vehicle test-ids are `exp-veh-bike`, `exp-veh-three_wheeler`, `exp-veh-mini_truck`, `exp-veh-truck` (not moto/tricycle/mini_camion/camion — those are display labels). This is a doc-only fix; behaviour is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpressWizard.jsx MultiStopBuilder auto-syncs first stop from draft.pickup/drop via useEffect keyed on `place_id` — solid pattern for the 'first shipment locked to Step 1' requirement.
Backend /quote/multi_stop returns `extra_stop_surcharge` and `extra_stops` correctly, but frontend does not surface it — small UX regression already flagged as UI bug.
Vehicle codes exposed via /api/express/vehicles are `bike/three_wheeler/mini_truck/truck`; the SendServiceTiles SERVICE_TYPE_MAP correctly uses `multiple_shipments` for the multi tile.
test_credentials: Not needed — customer OTP not required to reach /send/book/details or /send/book/vehicle. sessionStorage draft seeding used to jump straight into Step 3/4.
seed_data_creation: In-memory: seeded sessionStorage key `baked_express_draft` with service_type=multiple_shipments, 1-3 stops using Abidjan coords (5.29-5.36 lat, -3.98..-4.08 lng).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Backend Phase B/C/E all green (26/26). 2) Multi-stop tile→wizard flow works; first shipment locked; add/remove/reorder + counter chip verified. 3) /api/express/quote/multi_stop is invoked correctly on Step 4 with live prices for 4 vehicles. 4) Only bug is the missing `extra_stop_surcharge` row in the ⓘ breakdown component (ExpressWizard.jsx renderCard lines 715-731). 5) CARGO sanity confirmed. 6) Actual vehicle codes: bike, three_wheeler, mini_truck, truck.
rca of the issue: ExpressWizard.jsx renderCard breakdown (lines 715-731) enumerates known Row lines from the quote payload but forgets to include the multi-stop-only field `extra_stop_surcharge`. The field is returned by /api/express/quote/multi_stop (confirmed via curl: 500 XOF per extra shipment) and is included in `q.total`, but it is invisible to the customer in the price breakdown. Repro: seed sessionStorage with service_type=multiple_shipments and stops.length >= 2, navigate to /send/book/vehicle, click ⓘ on any vehicle card — the breakdown lacks the surcharge line. Mitigation: insert `{q.extra_stop_surcharge > 0 && <Row label={t('send.wizard.extra_stop_surcharge', { n: q.extra_stops })} value={money(q.extra_stop_surcharge)} />}` right after the existing `surcharge` row and add the i18n key in fr/en customer.json.
